title: Those Who Know God Can Trust Him
story:
A young girl was learning to ride a bicycle.

Her father walked beside her, holding the back of the bicycle while she tried to keep her balance.

At first, she was nervous and kept looking down at the wheels.

Whenever she became afraid, she called out, "Dad, are you there?"

Her father would answer, "I am right here. Keep going."

Because she knew her father was beside her, she slowly became more confident.

One day, her father let go for a few seconds without telling her.

She continued riding because she trusted that he would not let her fall.

Knowing someone we trust changes the way we face difficult situations.

Psalm 9 reminds us that those who know God's name put their trust in Him because He does not abandon those who seek Him.

Knowing God is more than knowing facts about Him.

It means developing a relationship with Him, learning His character, remembering His faithfulness, and choosing to trust Him even when circumstances are uncertain.

There will be moments when life feels difficult and we may wonder what will happen next.

At those times, remembering who God is can give us courage.

He is faithful, loving, righteous, and trustworthy.

He does not forget those who seek Him.

Sometimes we may not understand why God allows certain things to happen, but we can still trust His character.

A child may not understand why a parent makes certain decisions, but trust grows from knowing that the parent cares.

In the same way, our confidence in God grows as we know Him more deeply.

Spend time with God through prayer and His Word.

Remember the ways He has helped you in the past and allow those memories to strengthen your faith for today.

When fear tells you that you are alone, remember God's promise that He will not abandon those who seek Him.

You can trust the God who knows you, loves you, and remains faithful.
life_lesson: The more you know God's character and faithfulness, the more confidently you can trust Him. Seek Him sincerely and remember that He will not abandon those who seek Him.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being faithful and for never abandoning those who seek You.

Help me know You more deeply through Your Word and through prayer.

When I face uncertainty, remind me of Your faithfulness and help me trust You.

When fear makes me feel alone, remind me that You are near.

Teach me to trust Your character even when I do not understand my circumstances.

Help me remember the ways You have guided, protected, and helped me in the past.

Give me a heart that sincerely seeks You and desires to walk closely with You each day.

When I am tempted to depend only on my own understanding, help me place my confidence in You.

Thank You that I can call upon You at any time and know that You hear me.

Strengthen my faith and help me remain faithful to You through every season of life.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
How well do you really know God's character and faithfulness?

What past experience reminds you that God has been faithful to you?

What area of your life do you need to trust God with more completely today?
verse: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, Lord, have never forsaken those who seek You.
